name: Town Hall
es_wird_bereits_gefeiert: There is already a celebration going on.
celebrationDescription: Celebrations will produce culture points (CP) immediately. Since a celebration lasts so long, some time is needed until you can begin another. Hosting a small celebration will give culture points based on the village it is hosted in, up to a maximum of [CP_SMALL_CELEBRATION] culture points. However, with your town hall at level [LEVEL], you can host a great celebration that gives culture points based on all of your villages, up to a maximum of [CP_GREAT_CELEBRATION] culture points.
onVacation: You are in vacation mode, so you are not allowed to hold a celebration.
noTownHall: There is no town hall in the village.
